GeneDef.label: compliant mind
GeneDef.description: A pliant, suggestible psyche. This pawn is conditioned to a control collar far faster than normal and shakes off that conditioning far more slowly. Prized by slavers.

GeneDef.label: iron will
GeneDef.description: An unbreakable, stubborn psyche. This pawn resists collar conditioning fiercely and throws it off quickly once free. A nightmare to keep as a pet.

GeneDef.label: predatory drive
GeneDef.description: A deep-seated urge to dominate. This pawn is far more likely to prey on the vulnerable, harassing and forcing themselves on others without remorse.

GeneDef.label: submissive nature
GeneDef.description: A psyche that yearns to yield. This pawn is naturally submissive, breaks to a collar with startling ease, and settles into being owned as though born to it.

GeneDef.label: docile temperament
GeneDef.description: A placid, biddable temperament. This pawn rarely resists and takes to conditioning more readily than most.
